Field.Label: Controls how much detail LightTools writes to the Indigo Event Log. Higher levels are useful when troubleshooting; lower levels keep the log quieter during normal operation.

• None — only errors are logged • Informational — plugin lifecycle, scene saves, flash starts, etc. • Detailed — adds per-device action results (e.g. "Turning OFF relay X") • Debug — adds monitor decision reasoning (per-tick change detection) • Extended Debug — adds full state dumps every monitor cycle (very verbose; use only when actively troubleshooting)
